Life is hard. But at some point, you have to choose your hard.

Because whether we realize it or not, the decisions we make today are slowly becoming the life we’ll look back on one day.

I’m obsessed 😍 Here’s how to do it 👇🏼

1. Upload a picture to your stories, go to text, choose “literature” font, type O and you’re going to enlarge the O over the main focus point in the video

2. Go to draw, click the 3rd marker at the top, choose your color, hold your thumb down until it turns that color

3. Click the eraser button and erase out the middle part of the O 

4. Now add what you want to say at the top, I’m using headline font 

5. Add your link at the bottom. You can add text over top to create your own button if it doesn’t look as aesthetic as you want and it’s still clickable
